title: Dobby Plugin License Artifact v3
description: Wire shape of a signed v3 plugin license artifact (ADR-0060, docs/specs/license-import.md). Schema validity proves shape only: the grant decision additionally requires signature verification against a trusted license key, keyId agreement between payload and signature, device-key and package-fingerprint binding, revision monotonicity and the lifecycle truth table in license-v3-lifecycle-truth-table.md. The frozen v2 schema has no compatibility reader; see artifact-compatibility-matrix.md.

deviceKeyHash.$comment: ADR-0063 derivation: lowercase-hex SHA-256 over canonical JSON { algorithmVersion: "dobby-license-device-fingerprint-v1", machineGuid, stableDeviceId }. It is not a hash of any device public key. schemaVersion 3 implies the -v1 derivation; a derivation change requires a new schemaVersion, so no derivation selector is carried here and no host tries multiple derivations.

gracePeriodDays.$comment: ADR-0060 requires a small explicit grace ceiling. Grace grants FullAccess after expiry, so the signed value is capped at 90 days and the host re-applies this ceiling independently of the artifact.

keyId.$comment: ADR-0062 § 1 canonical vendor selector <purpose-short>-<prod|test>-<YYYY-MM>. purpose-short is bijective with the signing purpose, so a license artifact may only name a key from the license ring; a plugin-package or recovery selector here is a shape violation rejected before signature verification (key-purpose confusion, ADR-0059). Format conformance is not trust: the host still requires an exact match in its license ring.

utc.$comment: Field ranges are bounded, not merely digit-counted: a two-digit-per-component pattern accepts 2026-99-99T99:99:99Z, which reaches the typed parser as an out-of-range instant and turns a shape error into a parse/arithmetic failure path (range overflow). Residual calendar validity the pattern cannot express -- 2026-02-30, non-leap 02-29 -- stays with the typed parser; leap-second :60 is deliberately outside the accepted set.

keyId.$comment: Cross-field obligation JSON Schema cannot express: this keyId MUST equal payload.keyId, and a verifier MUST reject a mismatch before trusting the payload. Selecting the verification key from one member while taking authority from the other would accept a substituted key identity (ADR-0062 keyId selector).
